comment: What :gpu ships that is read as a resource, declared by glob rather than
The toolkit's shaders, compiled by :gpu:compileShaders into SPIR-V, DXIL and
MSL, and the manifest of their sources' hashes. ShaderLibrary reads them
with getResourceAsStream in whichever format the device takes, so an image
needs all three families: the machine it runs on decides which is read.
The ray tracer's shader library, compiled by :gpu:compileRayShaders into
SPIR-V alone, which its own Vulkan device reads.
